meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Bilkul. **₹3,000 ke andar** abhi mujhe jo options mil rahe hain, unmein main running ke liye ye prefer karunga:

### [Decathlon JOGFLOW 100 Superior Grip Cushioned Running Shoes]()
*₹1,599*

### [Decathlon Jogflow 190.1 Men Cushioned]()
*₹2,499*

### [Puma Men's Razz Running Shoes]()
*₹1,499*

### [adidas Men Restound Running Shoes]()
*₹1,959*

### Meri ranking

1. **🥇 Decathlon JOGFLOW 100 — ₹1,599**  
   Daily **3–5 km running/walking** ke liye meri top budget pick. 4.6/5 rating aur 4,100+ reviews listed hain. [Decathlon JOGFLOW 100 Superior Grip Cushioned Running Shoes]()

2. **🥈 Decathlon Jogflow 190.1 — ₹2,499**  
   Agar aap ₹2,500 tak spend kar sakte ho, ye **zyada cushioning** ke liye better option hai. 4.6/5 aur ~1,900 reviews listed hain. [Decathlon Jogflow 190.1 Men Cushioned]()

3. **🥉 Puma Razz — ₹1,499**  
   Brand preference hai aur running ke saath casual use bhi karna hai to achha value option. [Puma Men's Razz Running Shoes]()

4. **adidas Restound — ₹1,959**  
   adidas chahiye aur ₹2,000 ke aas-paas rehna hai to consider kar sakte ho. [adidas Men Restound Running Shoes]()

**Agar mujhe ek hi lena ho:** **JOGFLOW 100** — paisa bachao aur ₹1,600 ke aas-paas decent running shoe mil raha hai.  
Agar aap **regular 5–10 km runs** karte ho, to **Jogflow 190.1** par extra ₹900 spend karna zyada sensible hai.

Waise current sale listings mein **ASICS JOLT 4 ~₹2,069** aur **Adidas Duramo SL ~₹2,499** bhi ₹3,000 ke andar dikh rahe hain, isliye size/color ke hisaab se unki deal mil jaaye to main unhe bhi shortlist karunga. [magicdrop.in](https://magicdrop.in/drops/best-running-shoes-under-3000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Aap mujhe bas bata do: men ya women, aapka shoe size, aur running kitni (3 km / 5 km / 10 km+) karte ho — main ₹3,000 ke andar 3 exact best options choose kar dunga.**
